title: eugenia hastilis
intro: Eugenia hastilis, commonly known as the mountain apple, is a plant species native to the Philippines. It is prized for its potential health benefits, which include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties that may help alleviate symptoms of anxiety and insomnia, as well as its potential to reduce fever and soothe skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Eugenia hastilis are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which have been shown to exhibit anti-cancer and anti-bacterial activities. Further research is needed to confirm the efficacy of Eugenia hastilis for medicinal purposes.
